contradictions.explanation: If Dara, Cleo, and Yara are all pairwise on different teams, that requires at least three teams just for them, but combined with Finn and Vik also needing team assignments among only three teams, this is not inherently impossible, however the constraints force Dara, Cleo, and Yara to occupy all three teams individually, which is consistent only if no further contradiction arises; yet stating there are exactly three teams while also implying a strict pairwise distinctness for only three people leaves no room for Finn and Vik to share a team with any of them without violating the minimal team count needed, creating an inconsistency in team distribution.
